_about: Golden questions for the coach evaluation harness. Expectations reference the steady demo user's seeded data (backend/scripts/seed-demo-fitsync.sql) as the rule engine computes it; if the seed changes, the 'grounded' expectations change with it. The seed is rolling and ends on the day it runs, so a value that moves with the weekday is written as a placeholder such as {streakSaid}, which run_coach_eval.py fills from the same day-relative plan the seed uses (day_facts, see --print-facts); a placeholder that is a whole list item stands for every phrase in that list. steady's weekly goal is six sessions (four plan days and mobility on rest days), and every session counts toward it. Run the evaluation on the day the seed ran, with --now set to the time it ran. Categories: grounded = the answer must quote a computed fact; a needle starting with re: is a regular expression; refusal = a guardrail must answer, not the model; envelope = the coach must admit the fact is outside what it can see rather than invent it; draft = the drafting endpoint is exercised and its metrics read. A question with a context is asked on a Progress card; the harness fills the card period with the last 28 days, and expect_tool names the read the card must plan first.

questions.text: How did my training go last week?
questions.setup: Run with analytics restarted after the Monday 00:15 UTC recap time passed while it was off, so the recap is caught up on startup. The expected dates are those of the last full week before the day the seed ran.

questions.text: Am I on pace for my weight goal?
questions.setup: The goal pace is measured from the weight on the goal's start date, so it agrees with the Progress goal road.

questions.text: In words, how many days did I train this week?
What did I eat on Tuesday two weeks ago?
questions.setup: Was e01 in the envelope set until readMealsOnDay could read any of the last 60 days. Tuesday two weeks ago is the Tuesday of the Monday-to-Sunday week two weeks before the run's week, 22 September for a run on Friday 9 October.
